title: ContentNode
description: One addressable typed node in an Edition's ordered hierarchy: a book, chapter, verse, surah, page-independent paragraph, table, figure, utterance… Hierarchy depth is unconstrained. Text lives in TextFragments, never on the node itself; non-text-bearing nodes simply have no fragments.

parentId.description: null only for the edition's single root node.

ordinal.description: 0-based position among siblings; defines document order together with the ancestor chain.

depth.description: 0 for the root. Derivable; included for cheap client rendering.

code.description: Stable canonical code when this node is a code-addressed reference level (e.g. 'JHN'). Language-independent.

refOrdinal.description: 1-based canonical number when this node is an ordinal-addressed reference level (chapter 3, verse 16, page 2). Independent of 'ordinal': canonical numbering may skip or repeat positions.

label.description: Display label ('John', '3', 'Chapter IV', 'Interviewer'). NEVER used for reference resolution.

heading.description: Heading text associated with the node (e.g. a section title), when not modeled as a child heading node.

language.description: Override of the edition language for this subtree.

sourceLocalId.description: The node's id in the source document (EPUB anchor, TEI xml:id, parser Unit.id). Not globally unique.

locators.description: Physical location(s) of the whole node. A node spanning pages carries one locator per page region; fragment-level locators are preferred when finer granularity exists.
